title: customers.measurement-template-version-retired.v1
description: A measurement-template version stopped taking new captures. Retirement invalidates nothing: measurements already taken render through the version they were captured under, forever (docs/prd/measurement-templates.md section 11). This is the write that can strand a published catalogue. The retirement command refuses to retire a template's last published version while a published catalogue points at it, but it asks Catalog through a contract and then writes to its own schema, so a catalogue publication committing in that window was validated against a template this retirement has since emptied. INV-MTV-06 is therefore reconciled by this event rather than guaranteed by the guard alone, which is what G-6 promises for every cross-module reference.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the version was retired, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The template, not the version. Ordering is preserved per template, so a retirement cannot be delivered before the publication that superseded it.

organisationId.description: The organisation whose template it is. A reconciliation is scoped to it.

templateVersionId.description: The version that was retired. Measurements pinned to it still render through it.

templateCode.description: The template's stable machine key, such as MT_BLOUSE_PATTERN.

versionNumber.description: The version's number, for a message a person reads.

templateStillPublishable.description: Whether the template still has a published version after this retirement. False is the case that can strand a catalogue. It is derived state and the only such field on the payload, because it is the fact the event is about; a consumer still re-reads before acting, since the payload says what was true when the write committed and a reconciliation asks again.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
